appDescription: Gil-wi Anbu lets family and friends leave voice messages that open on the road. While driving, the driver can save the current spot by voice and turn it into a message after parking.

function.name: SAVE_SPOT
function.description: Save the car's current location as a temporary spot while driving, so the driver can leave a message there after parking. Use when the user says things like 'save this spot' or 'remember this place'.

memo.description: Optional short note the driver said about this spot, in the driver's own words (e.g. 'nice coffee shop').

function.name: UNDO_SPOT
function.description: Delete the most recently saved temporary spot. Use when the user says things like 'cancel what I just saved'.

function.name: COUNT_SPOTS
function.description: Tell how many temporary spots the driver saved today. Use when the user asks how many spots they saved.
